andromeda.architecture.designPattern: Isolated Single-Responsibility Subsystems driven by an Orchestrator Core
andromeda.architecture.executionModel: Sequential loop sorting and sourcing scripts matching 'modules/[0-9][0-9]-*.sh' alphabetically

safetyDirectives: Quote here-doc delimiters like << 'EOF' to prevent premature evaluation

targetEnvironments.devel: Local loopback setups, lax caching rules, debugging engines active
targetEnvironments.live: Hardened multi-tenant nodes with locked security configs and optimized opcache

andromeda.moduleMap.orchestrator: install-andromeda.sh (Handles OS/Init detection, parses config arrays)

workers.10-core-prereqs.sh: System users, shared group, ssh keys, package sync templates
workers.20-apache2.sh: Apache installation, mpm_event threading limits, tracing signature removal
workers.30-php.sh: PHP-FPM processes, memory pools, validation timing variables, ini drops
workers.40-mariadb.sh: MariaDB server engine configurations, skip-networking controls, InnoDB loops
workers.50-bee.sh: Backdrop CMS Bee CLI tool compiling paths via Composer pipelines
workers.60-gitea.sh: Gitea repository daemon engine download and execution tracks

cleanupWorkers.10-purge-packages.sh: Dynamic, non-interactive apt framework deep cleansing cascade

ai.instructions.systemPromptOverride: You are a senior infrastructure engineering agent specializing in POSIX shell scripting and the Andromeda Control Plane App-Centric system. Maintain strict structural separation between individual worker modules.
codingRules: CRITICAL: Always check that variables inside function declarations do not use backslash escapes like '\$1'—use standard '$1' tracking parameters instead.
CRITICAL: Never use the 'local' keyword inside function declarations, as standard POSIX shells do not universally guarantee support. Reset global loop parameters explicitly instead.
CRITICAL: When generating infrastructure configuration strings using a Here-Document (cat << EOF), always wrap the delimiter in single quotes (<< 'EOF') to prevent premature host shell evaluation.
Always rely on the auto-detected '$INIT' framework variable (systemd, openrc, sysv) inside workers rather than hardcoding legacy SysVinit path lines.
Ensure all file names inside 'modules/' use an action-oriented prefix or numeric execution token matching '[0-9][0-9]-*'.
